subject: Consolidated VM audit packet and remediation mapping request
messages:
From: Danielle Price <danielle.price@finbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: FinBank Security Team <security@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Consolidated VM audit packet and remediation mapping

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our SOC 2 readiness checklist we're collecting a single, consolidated vulnerability management audit packet from each vendor. Can you provide: 

- A machine-readable scan index for Q2 2026 mapping scan IDs to asset groups and dates (CSV preferred).
- A consolidated CVE -> fix mapping that includes CVE id, affected service, remediation commit/link, mitigation applied, and closure date.
- Your current scan cadence and the SLA targets for critical/important/medium findings (time-to-ack, time-to-fix).
- Any exception/waiver logs for third-party dependencies in the last 12 months.

Would you be able to deliver these items by end of week (Friday, 2026-06-25)? If not, please propose a revised delivery date. We may need an internal acceptance note from a technical owner.

Thanks,
Danielle Price
Senior Information Security Manager
FinBank

Attachment: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Price <danielle.price@finbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated VM audit packet and remediation mapping

Danielle,

Appreciate the clear list — we can do this. High level plan:

- I will assemble a CSV scan index (redwood_vm_scan_index_2026Q2.csv) showing scan_id, asset_group, scanner_type, scan_date, and link to exported results.
- Karthik will own the CVE mapping spreadsheet (cve_fixes_mapping_2026-06-21.xlsx) that maps each CVE to a PR/commit link, remediation owner, mitigation notes, and closure timestamp.
- Mina will provide the SLA table and exception log; we’ll include the last 12 months of third-party waivers.

We may need to redact internal ticket identifiers for some low-level ops tickets — we will provide commit links and timestamps to satisfy evidence requirements while preserving internal ticket content.

Deliverables and ETA: Friday EOD (2026-06-25) as requested. If any item needs additional time (e.g., third-party waiver reconciliations), I’ll flag by Wednesday.

I’m attaching a draft SLA commitment PDF for review (sla_commitment_redwood_2026-06-21.pdf) and will follow up with the CSV/XLSX.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sla_commitment_redwood_2026-06-21.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated VM audit packet and remediation mapping

On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 11:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Danielle,
>
> Appreciate the clear list — we can do this. High level plan:
> ...

Hi Danielle — quick technical note from engineering:

- For CVEs we will include the canonical CVE ID and link to the commit in our public repo (or an internal commit link for infra-only fixes). Where fixes were deployed via rolling release, we’ll include the first deployment timestamp and the canary completion timestamp.
- For host/service mapping we will attach a short mapping file showing service_name -> asset_group -> region (to help your asset inventory reconciliation).
- If FinBank requires unredacted internal ticket content for a specific CVE, please confirm and we can start an internal approval flow (this is rare but possible under a signed NDA addendum).

I’ve attached the initial CVE mapping snapshot (cve_fixes_mapping_2026-06-21.xlsx) — it contains 84 CVEs since 2025-06-01 with remediation links for each critical/important item. Expect a follow-up CSV with scan indices by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cve_fixes_mapping_2026-06-21.xlsx
From: Danielle Price <danielle.price@finbank.com>

Cc: FinBank Security Team <security@finbank.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated VM audit packet and remediation mapping

Marissa / Karthik — this is great, thank you.

Quick confirmation:
- The SLA PDF looks fine; we will accept the targets for time-to-ack and time-to-fix for critical/important/medium as stated.
- The CVE mapping spreadsheet meets our needs for the SOC 2 audit — we’ll note a couple of follow-up questions directly in the spreadsheet comments.
- Please include the machine-readable scan index CSV when available.

If everything arrives by Friday EOD we’ll mark this as received on our side and move forward with the control assessment. If any of the items slip beyond Friday, please ping me with a short note and new ETA.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll be in touch with comments in the doc.

Best,
Danielle
FinBank
